concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-pix-android-component]] — 2026-09-15-captured Pix Android Components Sessions/Advanced guide for request fields, InstantPaymentComponent, QR action, versioned payment expiry, refunds and asynchronous TEST simulation.
warnings: Advanced sessionValidity default is 1 hour on Checkout API v71 or earlier and 24 hours on v72 or later; the captured TEST examples contain past explicit expiry timestamps.
Pending/qrCode is not payment success; test Customer Area offer promotion is a simulation and does not prove an actual Pix transfer.
Sessions shopperStatement maximum 140 characters differs from Advanced supplied-value under-60-character instruction; keep flow scopes distinct.
